title: سه رود، یک دریا
logline_fa: سه رود با سه رنگ از سه سو می‌آیند؛ هر کدام کوچک است و هیچ‌کدام برتر نیست، اما در یک نقطه به هم می‌رسند و یک دریای پهن می‌شوند.
ratio_note: 16:9 designed first as a wide map, then a 9:16 re-design as a vertical stack

protagonist.what: three water streams (teal, amber, indigo), equal peers
protagonist.build: 3 SVG stroke paths animated by stroke-dashoffset, width grows with flow; same weight and speed
protagonist.state_change: three thin separate lines -> one thick merged delta -> sea with all three colours still visible

beats.what: three sources appear one after the other, equal spacing
three paths wind toward the centre in parallel
merge point: widths add, colours blend as marbling
sea, copy, three colours still visible in the flow

payoffs.viewer_gets: the third arrives exactly on beat, equal
all three touch at once and width triples
marbled colours swirl but stay readable

assets: SVG paths, marbling via layered opacity, wave texture
kit sfx: pluck x3, water boom, shimmer, ambience

acceptance: run-gates hero-size/edge-touch clean on both ratios
three sources arrive within 40 ms of the grid
transition strip: no colour pops at the merge
lab.risk: medium; marbling look in CSS only
